  budget (the noisy graph must be published first).

operators, comparisons (==, <, >), if/else, for-loops outside sum(...), conditions inside sum(...),

  budget (the noisy graph must be published first).

operators, comparisons (==, <, >), if/else, for-loops outside sum(...), conditions inside sum(...),
